title: Same Spin? Angular Velocity Explained Simply | PUC Physics Class 11
description:
On a merry-go-round the outer horse races while the inner one strolls. Aarav spins his upside-down bicycle wheel: the valve on the rim covers far more distance than the reflector near the hub. So which one is turning faster? In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Physics (NCERT Chapter 3, Motion in a Plane) we learn angular displacement and angular velocity.

We define angular position and angular displacement, see what one radian really is, then spin a live wheel: both points turn through the same angle on one straight angle-time line, while their arcs and speeds differ. We derive ω = Δθ/Δt, s = rθ, v = rω and ω = 2π/T = 2πν step by step, compare the reflector and the valve side by side, and answer two pause-and-think questions. Then a worked example on a ceiling fan, the exam trap about degrees, an original NEET pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, JEE Main and NEET students.

In this video:
0:00 A merry-go-round, a fan and Aarav's spinning wheel
0:29 Angular position, angular displacement and the radian
1:00 Live simulation: same angle, different arcs
1:44 ω = Δθ/Δt and v = rω, step by step
2:42 Reflector vs valve + pause and think
3:39 Worked example: a ceiling fan
4:17 Exam trap: degrees in v = rω
4:43 Practice question (NEET pattern)
5:21 Recap and three questions to answer
